about: CupRounds Launcher: what Melty starts. It manages the mashup's own ROUNDS mod profile from Thunderstore, then starts ROUNDS (hidden card engine) and Cuphead together.

rows.does: list ROUNDS mods from Thunderstore with icon name, author, downloads, rating, description
search box and a Cards-only filter (on by default)
install a mod and all its dependencies into the mashup's ROUNDS profile
enable or disable an installed mod without deleting it
update installed mods to their latest version
import an r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager profile code
copy the mod list of a local r2modman / Thunderstore Mod Manager ROUNDS profile (reinstalled fresh from Thunderstore)
start ROUNDS hidden with the profile, wait for its cards, then start Cuphead with the plugin; close the ROUNDS it started when Cuphead closes
skip the launcher window and play at once (Melty test runs, or --autoplay)
status line and log of what the launcher is doing
